com.github.miachm.sods

Class Macro

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.github.miachm.sods.Macro
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Cloneable

    public class Macro
extends Object
implements Cloneable
    Represents a single macro module stored in an ODS file.

    An ODS file can contain Basic macros organised in libraries. Each Macro object corresponds to one module inside a library and holds the module's name, source language, and source code.

    The default language for programmatically-created macros is "StarBasic", which is what LibreOffice uses for Basic macros.
